title: China's Global-Governance Operating Map — 2026
adds: Not one program or legal/financial machine. BRI is a cooperation umbrella whose label finances nothing; GDI has the clearest project machinery (CIDCA pool, incubation vs achievement); GSI is a concept/cooperation framework (e.g., Saudi-Iran Beijing agreement as GSI-linked mediation); GCI is chiefly dialogue (UN International Day for Dialogue among Civilizations); GGI (Sept 2025) has a concept paper and Group of Friends but no general authority. Objects stop at their last evidenced G0-G7 state; Hambantota does not support the 'seized on default' shorthand; AIIB loans are not Chinese bilateral loans.
contribution_scope: Reviewed navigation description; read each source for its own claim and clock.
navigation_contribution: Compare the distinct Chinese initiative frameworks and follow named projects from an initiative label to funding, contracts and operating evidence.
summary_role: Exact saved study bottom line; object-local evidence date retained.
